summary.motor: UB SEDS N2O hybrid, HRAP design curve as flown by the OpenRocket model SWEET_V6
summary.source: tools/flight_profile/vehicle/SWEET_V6.ork, simulation IREC_STANDARDREPORT (OpenRocket 24.12), Time/Thrust/Motor mass columns; the motor file itself is not in the .ork
summary.thrust_note: OpenRocket logs burnout at 4.0 s; the last non-zero vertex is 3.9 s (40 N)
summary.propellant_note: OpenRocket carries 9.0 kg of motor mass to 0 at burnout in IREC_STANDARDREPORT (and in the current configuration); TESTFIRE_NOTFULLOXTANK and Simulations 1-3 use the same curve with 6.5 kg. The mass falls in proportion to the burnt impulse (max deviation 0.09 %), the same rule as flightsim.Motor. Whether it is N2O alone or N2O plus the fuel grain is not stated in the file.

motor_hardware.what: EntireMotor_nofuel mass object in the Oxidizer Tank tube (comment: the mass of the entire motor without fuel, paired with the .rse thrust file); part of the 40.84 kg stage override

summary.not_in_the_ork: grain dimensions, nozzle throat/exit, injector, O/F and chamber pressure: the .ork models the motor only as a thrust curve, a propellant mass and a hardware mass object
